method: Native captureStream/MediaRecorder. Workshop films copy each newly rendered GPU canvas once to a labelled capture canvas and request its native frame; no extra source frames are generated. No replay, interpolation or playback speed filter; codec-copy indexed containers retain all native encoded packet payloads and PTS. Shaders and initial weather warmed before capture. Thaw starts with a commanded March date and a natural transition to clear weather, then retains native M15 melt speed. Only the seasonal calendar diagnostic is accelerated and labelled in the video. Stage films use the actual shared engine; world films retain the real pilot.
